name: generated-production-60s
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; receipt=$(mktemp /tmp/closure-production-XXXXXX.json); trap 'rm -f "$receipt"' EXIT; timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/track-m/profile-production.ts production >"$receipt"; bun -e 'const text=await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text(); console.log(text); const result=JSON.parse(text.trim()); if(!result.proven||!result.checked)process.exit(1)' "$receipt"
